objectives.summary: The project aims to assist real estate agents by providing a user-friendly platform that enhances their online presence and daily activities. Key objectives include enabling agents to build websites quickly, manage client communications, and integrate with real estate boards and listings.

Agents can build their websites in minutes using the user-friendly platform.
The platform allows agents to share listings via social media with a single click.
Agents can manage contacts, calendar entries, and tasks, synchronizing them across mobile platforms.
The platform integrates a contacts database with agents' websites to capture leads instantly.
The initial version of the platform has been launched and is receiving positive feedback.

The platform is designed to be user-friendly, allowing agents to quickly build websites and maintain client communication through various digital tools. However, the project faced challenges in securing its funding goal of $35,307, which was not met by the deadline.
